description: This source file defines utility functions for handling TypeScript files, including path resolution, testing file detection, file collection, and code analysis helpers such as violation detection and AST node processing. It also manages module imports and caching, and provides functions to facilitate script execution based on the entry point.

methods.name: getTypeScript
methods.description: Lazily loads and caches the TypeScript module.

methods.name: resolveRepoRoot
methods.description: Determines the root directory of the repository based on the import URL.

methods.name: resolveSourceRoots
methods.description: Maps relative root paths to absolute paths based on the repository root.

methods.name: isTestLikeTypeScriptFile
methods.description: Checks if a filename matches common test-related suffixes to identify test files.

methods.name: collectTypeScriptFiles
methods.description: Recursively collects TypeScript files from a target path, optionally including test files.

methods.name: collectTypeScriptFilesFromRoots
methods.description: Collects TypeScript files from multiple source root directories.

methods.name: collectFileViolations
methods.description: Reads files and applies a violation-finding function to collect code issues.

methods.name: toLine
methods.description: Converts a source file node's position to a line number.

methods.name: getPropertyNameText
methods.description: Extracts text from property name nodes, including identifiers and literals.

methods.name: unwrapExpression
methods.description: Removes parentheses and type assertions from an expression to get the core expression.

methods.name: collectCallExpressionLines
methods.description: Collects line numbers of call expressions within a source file AST.

methods.name: isDirectExecution
methods.description: Determines if the script is being run directly from the command line.

methods.name: runAsScript
methods.description: Executes a main function if the script is run directly, with error handling.
